app.name: NetworkBench
app.description: Network performance benchmark for Windows using Microsoft NTTTCP
app.closeConfirmWarning: A benchmark session is currently running.
app.closeConfirmDescription: If you exit now, the benchmark in progress will be immediately cancelled and no official results will be recorded.

errors.NB-CONN-001: Cannot reach target host at the specified address.
errors.NB-CONN-001-desc: The remote host is not responding or unreachable at the specified address and port.
errors.NB-CONN-002: Host name cannot be resolved via DNS or mDNS.
errors.NB-CONN-002-desc: Could not resolve an IP address from the provided host name.
errors.NB-CONN-003-desc: The remote host actively rejected the control connection.
errors.NB-CONN-004: Remote service does not correspond to a NetworkBench instance.
errors.NB-CONN-004-desc: A service responded on the port, but it is not a compatible NetworkBench instance.
errors.NB-CONN-005: Control connection was unexpectedly interrupted during session.
errors.NB-CONN-005-desc: The control connection was lost during benchmark execution.
errors.NB-CONN-006-desc: Failed to verify the security certificate of the remote peer.
errors.NB-VERSION-001: Remote peer network protocol version is incompatible.
errors.NB-VERSION-001-desc: The remote NetworkBench protocol version is not compatible with this version.
errors.NB-PEER-001: Remote peer user rejected the benchmark request.
errors.NB-PEER-001-desc: The remote peer user declined to participate in the benchmark.
errors.NB-PEER-002-desc: No response was received from the remote peer within the expected 60-second window.
errors.NB-PEER-003: Remote host is busy running another benchmark session.
errors.NB-PEER-003-desc: The remote peer is currently engaged in another benchmark session.
errors.NB-PEER-004: Benchmark session was cancelled by remote peer.
errors.NB-PEER-004-desc: The remote peer user cancelled the benchmark session.
errors.NB-PEER-005: Pairing code does not match the code displayed on the peer.
errors.NB-PEER-005-desc: The entered security pairing code does not match the one generated on the remote peer.
errors.NB-PEER-006: Remote peer identity or certificate has changed.
errors.NB-PEER-006-desc: The peer's cryptographic key differs from previously trusted records.
errors.NB-PARAM-001-desc: The requested benchmark plan parameters exceed receiver limits.
errors.NB-PORT-001: Configured control port is already in use by another application.
errors.NB-PORT-001-desc: The local control port is already occupied by another application.
errors.NB-PORT-002: One or more ports in the data range are already occupied.
errors.NB-PORT-002-desc: Required data ports for this benchmark are not available on this machine.
errors.NB-FW-001: Windows Firewall is blocking the control channel.
errors.NB-FW-001-desc: The machine is visible on the network but Windows Firewall blocks the connection.
errors.NB-FW-002: Windows Firewall does not allow inbound traffic on NTTTCP ports.
errors.NB-FW-002-desc: Windows Firewall blocks inbound traffic on required benchmark data ports.
errors.NB-FW-003: Firewall is managed by group or system policy.
errors.NB-FW-003-desc: Windows Firewall settings are managed by system policy and cannot be altered locally.
errors.NB-FW-004-desc: UAC administrator elevation was rejected or cancelled during firewall configuration.
errors.NB-FW-005: Traffic blocked by an external network device.
errors.NB-FW-005-desc: Local firewall rules exist but traffic does not arrive; an intermediate firewall or router may be filtering packets.
errors.NB-ENGINE-001: NTTTCP benchmark engine was not found in expected path.
errors.NB-ENGINE-001-desc: Microsoft NTTTCP executable was not found at the expected location.
errors.NB-ENGINE-002: Cryptographic hash of NTTTCP does not match verified official binary.
errors.NB-ENGINE-002-desc: Engine binary checksum mismatch or antivirus blocked execution.
errors.NB-ENGINE-003: Benchmark receiver engine failed to start listening in time.
errors.NB-ENGINE-003-desc: The receiver engine did not start listening on the expected port in time.
errors.NB-ENGINE-004: Engine execution exceeded the expected time limit.
errors.NB-ENGINE-004-desc: The benchmark measurement process did not terminate within the allocated time window.
errors.NB-ENGINE-005: Engine measurement process terminated with an error.
errors.NB-ENGINE-005-desc: The engine process exited unexpectedly or returned a non-zero exit code.
errors.NB-ENGINE-006: Engine output does not contain expected measurement data.
errors.NB-ENGINE-006-desc: The XML output returned by the engine is missing essential benchmark statistics.
errors.NB-RESULT-001-desc: Measurement only completed for one of the two intended directions.
errors.NB-RESULT-002-desc: Excessive discrepancy detected between sender and receiver counters.
errors.NB-NIC-001-desc: The selected network adapter is no longer available or has been disconnected.
errors.NB-NIC-002: Network adapter changed state during benchmark.
errors.NB-NIC-002-desc: The network interface link or IP address changed during test execution.
errors.NB-NIC-003-desc: No matching IP address family (IPv4/IPv6) between both endpoints.
errors.NB-NIC-004-desc: No operational network adapter with local network connectivity was found.
errors.NB-PERM-001: Insufficient system permissions for the operation.
errors.NB-PERM-001-desc: The application lacks required permissions to complete the operation.
errors.NB-DISK-001: Insufficient disk space to store benchmark results.
errors.NB-DISK-001-desc: Less than 200 MB of free disk space remains on the application data volume.
errors.NB-DATA-001-desc: The local database file cannot be read or has structural corruption.
errors.NB-UNEXPECTED-001-desc: An unclassified error occurred during benchmark execution.
errors.NB-INTERNAL-001: An unexpected internal error occurred in the application.
errors.NB-INTERNAL-001-desc: An error occurred in an internal application subsystem.

settings.title: Application Settings
settings.subtitle: System preferences, network, data and lifecycle
settings.networkControlPortDesc: TCP port used for coordination and bilateral handshake between peers (default 7411).
settings.defaultPortNotice: Leave blank to use standard port (7411). Range: 1024–65000.
settings.mdnsDiscoveryDesc: Allows other computers with NetworkBench on the same local network to discover you automatically.
settings.autoAcceptTrustedDesc: Accept incoming benchmark requests from trusted peers without manual confirmation.
settings.autoAcceptSecurityNotice: For security reasons, auto-accept is disabled by default. Enable it only in trusted, secure networks.
settings.autostartDesc: Start NetworkBench minimized in the background when turning on the computer.
settings.minimizeToTrayDesc: Keep application in system tray when closing main window.
settings.firewallRulesDesc: Inspection of required rules for control and NTTTCP data traffic.
settings.localDataStorageDesc: Disk location of SQLite history database and configuration file.
settings.purgeConfirmWarning: This action will permanently delete all locally stored benchmark sessions. This operation cannot be undone.
settings.logLevelDesc: Detail of diagnostic logs generated by the application.
settings.debugLevelWarning: Debug level generates large amounts of temporary logs and is only recommended for troubleshooting.
settings.updatesDesc: Check for newer versions with verified cryptographic signatures.
settings.updateDeferredMessage: A benchmark is running. Update check is deferred until completion.
settings.aboutSubtitle: Local network benchmarking tool powered by Microsoft NTTTCP
settings.licenseNotice: Distributed under the GNU General Public License v3 (GPL-3.0-or-later). Free and open source software with no telemetry or external services.
settings.attributionNotice: Microsoft and NTTTCP are trademarks or components of Microsoft Corporation. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for third-party notices and licenses.

verdict.warn_title: Performance is slightly lower than expected
verdict.incomplete: The benchmark did not complete in both directions

observations.perf_warn: Throughput utilized {utilization}% of nominal link capacity
observations.perf_problem: Throughput only utilized {utilization}% of link capacity
observations.stability_variable: Moderate fluctuations were observed during measurement
observations.stability_very_variable: Throughput varied significantly during the test
observations.asymmetry: There is a {asymmetryPercent}% asymmetry between the two directions
observations.retransmissions_elevated: Slightly elevated TCP packet retransmission rate
observations.retransmissions_high: High TCP packet retransmission rate detected

causes.cable_or_switch: May be caused by a faulty cable, saturated switch, or speed auto-negotiation issue
causes.background_traffic: Other processes or devices may be consuming bandwidth on the network
causes.interference_or_buffer: May be caused by physical interference or adapter buffer issues
causes.asymmetric_route_or_firewall: Routing paths may differ or a firewall is deeply inspecting traffic in one direction
causes.packet_loss: Packet loss detected on the network path between both computers
causes.high_packet_loss: Severe congestion or collisions in switching infrastructure
causes.cpu_high: CPU usage was very high on one of the computers during the benchmark

tooltips.official_bps: Speed calculated exclusively from data received at the receiver, ensuring traffic arrived.
tooltips.stability: Measures flow consistency during measurement. Lower dispersion means higher stability.
tooltips.asymmetry: Relative difference between A→B throughput and B→A throughput.
tooltips.retransmissions: Proportion of TCP packets retransmitted due to network loss or delays.
tooltips.cpu_usage: Total system CPU percentage consumed during measurement.

history.title: Benchmark History
history.delete_confirm_desc: This action will permanently delete the associated results and samples.

advanced.title: Advanced Options
advanced.subtitle: Configure specific protocol parameters, directions, and boundaries
advanced.udp_notice: TCP and UDP answer different questions. TCP measures usable speed achieved by standard applications. UDP sends at an unthrottled rate to observe packet loss at that rate. Packet loss when transmitting at full link speed is expected.
advanced.simultaneous_notice: The simultaneous test runs concurrent sender and receiver on each host without port overlap (up to 32 streams per direction).

udp.title: UDP Benchmark Result
udp.target_exceeded: The target rate exceeded the link capacity
udp.no_asymmetry_notice: Sequential asymmetry analysis does not apply to UDP and simultaneous benchmarks.
